items.title: Zelensky proposes freezing front with Russia as first step to peace talks
items.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky on Wednesday called for the front line in Russia's war against to Ukraine to be frozen along current lines as a first step toward peace talks. His comments came as US special envoy Steve Witkoff met with Russia's President Vladimir Putin in Saint Petersburg.

items.title: How war in Lebanon has cost young people with autism and ADHD
items.description: Experts warn that war takes a heavy toll on neurodivergent people, who often rely on routine.

items.title: Russia releases imprisoned U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard following Trump's request
items.description: The announcement of Hubbard's release came as talks got underway between Putin and White House envoy Steve Witkoff in Saint Petersburg focused on the latest U.S. efforts to end the war in Ukraine.

items.title: Kremlin Rejects Energy Ceasefire But Says Full Peace Deal Requires Ukraine’s Participation
items.description: The Kremlin’s spokesperson said Putin is not considering an energy ceasefire with Ukraine but added that a full resolution of the war requires Ukrainian officials’ participation. Peskov also dismissed recent European peace proposals as unlikely to contribute constructively to a settlement.

After Witkoff Meeting, Putin 'Ready To Resume' US-Led Peace Talks With Ukraine
items.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin told US envoy Steve Witkoff that Moscow was willing to resume stalled, US-mediated peace talks with Ukraine, Kremlin foreign policy aide Yury Ushakov said after the two met at Constantine Palace in St. Petersburg.
